solicitations.title: Supply and Delivery of Office Furniture
solicitations.summary: Supply and delivery of modular office furniture (desks, task chairs, filing units) to the Embassy compound.

restrictions.note: Dubai consolidation point and nominated forwarder meet this comfortably.

solicitations.title: Procurement of Cleaning Supplies
solicitations.summary: One-time supply of commercial janitorial consumables and cleaning supplies.

solicitations.title: Supply of Caterpillar OEM Fuel Injectors
solicitations.summary: Supply of genuine Caterpillar OEM fuel injectors for Embassy generator sets.

restrictions.t: Award conditioned on an authorized Caterpillar dealer authorization letter addressed to Madison & Main LLC
restrictions.note: The UAE Caterpillar-authorized supplier can issue this authorization — this resolves the condition.
Legitimate specification; source genuine product through the authorized UAE channel.

solicitations.route: Secure the authorized-dealer authorization letter from the UAE Caterpillar supplier naming Madison & Main LLC and submit it with the quotation. This single instrument reclassifies the solicitation as BID-eligible.

solicitations.title: Supply of Paper Products (Hygiene Consumables)
solicitations.summary: Routine supply of toilet tissue, paper towels and related hygiene paper products for the mission.

restrictions.t: Solicitation asserts a trade/import license requirement for a commercial paper-products supply
restrictions.note: Consistent with copy-forwarded boilerplate. A commercial off-the-shelf consumable delivered to post should not require a special trade license. Strong candidate for clarification under the Q&A provision.

solicitations.route: Submit a clarification request under the Q&A provision (due 2026-10-08) asking the Contracting Officer to confirm whether a trade/import license is a mandatory condition of award, or whether a standard commercial quotation with active SAM registration suffices. If waived, the solicitation is BID-eligible.
solicitations.challengeDraft:
Reference: 19UG5026Q0031 — Request for Clarification

For this commercial supply of standard paper products delivered to post, we respectfully request confirmation as to whether a trade/import license constitutes a mandatory condition of award, or whether a standard commercial quotation accompanied by the vendor's active SAM.gov registration is sufficient.

solicitations.title: Renovation of Compound Perimeter Wall
solicitations.summary: Construction and renovation of the perimeter security wall, including excavation and on-site works.

restrictions.t: Construction requiring on-site labor and performance/payment bonds
restrictions.note: Outside the source-and-ship model; requires bonding capacity and an on-site workforce.

citation.quote: The Contractor shall furnish performance and payment bonds (SF-25 / SF-25A) and shall perform all work on-site at the Embassy compound, Addis Ababa.

solicitations.title: Local Guard Force Services
solicitations.summary: Provision of uniformed local guard force services at the mission.

restrictions.t: Guard/staffing service — restricted category requiring on-site personnel
restrictions.note: Requires a local workforce, local licensing and RSO clearance.

citation.quote: The contractor shall provide, employ, supervise and insure uniformed guard personnel on-site at U.S. Embassy San José on a 24/7 basis.
